test_reading_cg: test reading concept graph data and verify nodes and edges are created correctly in DynamicWorldGraph
create_cg_edges_with_objects: create concept graph edges from JSON data with include_objects set to True in DynamicWorldGraph
create_cg_edges_without_objects: create concept graph edges from JSON data with include_objects set to False to exclude object nodes
check_has_node: check if a specific node exists in the DynamicWorldGraph using has_node method
check_has_edge: check if an edge exists between two nodes in the DynamicWorldGraph using has_edge method
